_meta.scope: Fresh application, news, contract and agreement sweep across the eight vendors in data/vendors.json plus adjacent advanced-reactor developers.
_meta.method: Targeted web searches followed by reads of the cited primary source. Existing records were checked before promotion.
_meta.rule: Definitive contracts, regulatory actions, achieved milestones and non-binding memoranda remain separate classes. An agreement is not treated as a reactor order unless the source names a purchase or committed capacity.

promoted.class: formal regulatory step under an existing partnership

application_examples.result: promoted with measured 240 kW demonstration load; commercial campus figures remain contextual
promoted as a correction: DOE's 270-280 MW estimate makes a megaton hub a fleet or larger-reactor load, not one microreactor
promoted without an MW band; NASA supports continuous liquefaction and zero-boil-off duty but not the prior 5-30 MW estimate
promoted without an MW band; Canada supports the remote-site and bulk-fuel case but not the prior demand or availability estimate
promoted with DOE's 21 MW gross cogeneration example and process-steam duty

vendor_coverage.result: DOE-confirmed criticality; no new customer contract value
no new microreactor-specific contract beyond Janus found
company Janus release confirms milestone-based OTA; value and delivery date remain undisclosed
Utah land agreement surfaced, but no primary document with commercial power terms was found; not promoted
no post-July customer contract found; Crusoe partnership already predates this sweep
no new reactor or fuel contract after the existing Meta prepayment and Centrus LOI found

adjacent_coverage.result: UK GDA acceptance promoted; up-to-6-GW plan remains an intention, not an order
Enveniam MOU promoted as non-binding; no customer, site, capacity, price or delivery date

excluded: A search result described a future-dated September 30 NASA award to Antares. The capture date is September 21, so it was excluded.
Secondary reports of a Valar Utah land agreement were not promoted without the underlying executed document and commercial terms.
General announcements, financing and media appearances were excluded unless they changed a contract, application, regulatory or operating state.
